channel.title: BigEnergyCo - Free Solar & Battery Storage Knowledge
channel.description: Educational guides, chemistry comparisons, and engineering insights for DIY and off-grid solar and battery storage systems worldwide. Nothing for sale.

item.title: Off-Grid vs Grid-Tied Solar: Which Pays Back Faster in 2026?
item.description: Real payback numbers for Hawaii, Nigeria, and Germany - worked step by step from five years of satellite weather. When independence wins, when bill-cutting wins, and what the hardware truly costs.

item.title: DIY Battery Storage: The Complete Guide to LiFePO4 and Sodium-Ion Builds in 2026
item.description: Compare DIY battery storage options for LiFePO4 and sodium-ion. Learn cost, safety, and modularity benefits of building your own off-grid or backup system.
